freeride.http_headers_helper: p=$(sed -n 's/.*"project"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([0-9a-fA-F-]\{36\}\)".*/\1/p' .freeride.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); r=''; for f in CLAUDE.md .claude/CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; b=$(tr -d '\r' < "$f" | sed -n '/<!-- freeride-start -->/,/<!-- freeride-end -->/p'); [ -n "$b" ] || continue; s=$(printf '%s\n' "$b" | sed -n 's/.*<!-- freeride-rules: \([0-9-]*\) -->.*/\1/p' | head -n 1); c=$(printf '%s\n' "$b" | grep -v '^FreeRide project:' | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//' | grep -v '^$' | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1); r="$r${r:+ }$f=${s:-none},$c"; done; h='"X-FreeRide-Version":"plugin-0.1.22"'; [ -n "$p" ] && h="$h,\"X-FreeRide-Project\":\"$p\""; [ -n "$r" ] && h="$h,\"X-FreeRide-Rules\":\"$r\""; printf '{%s}' "$h"
